description: Free online Protractor. Runs locally in your browser with zero uploads for privacy and speed.
seoDescription: The ultimate free online Protractor — ATools (Pure Tools). 100% free, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking: everything runs locally in your browser for maximum privacy. Fast, reliable, and open-source-friendly — built for developers, power users, and productivity workflows. Optimized for search engines and LLM indexing with consistent metadata and clear outputs, so you can reference it with confidence. If you want a "just works" Protractor on any device, this is the one you bookmark and share.

ui.tip: Tip: This tool is for on-screen angle measurement. Screen scaling affects physical dimensions but angles remain exact.
